title: Consolidate planning documents into unified ROADMAP.md
body:
Project planning was fragmented across 6 documents (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md, OBJECTOS_INTEGRATION_ROADMAP.md, original ROADMAP.md, console dev plan, update summary, copilot instructions) with ~40% duplicate content. This created confusion about priorities and timelines.

## Changes

### Consolidated ROADMAP.md
- **87% compression** (71KB → 11KB) while preserving all critical information
- Quarterly structure (Q1-Q4 2026) with clear milestones:
  - Q1: Infrastructure (test coverage 80%+, i18n, performance)
  - Q2: ObjectOS integration (multi-tenancy, RBAC, enterprise features)
  - Q3: Ecosystem (plugins, visual designer, real-time collaboration)
  - Q4: Commercialization (Cloud platform, $500K revenue target)
- Current status: 28 packages, 91+ components, v0.5.0 achievements
- Identified gaps: P0 (test coverage 62%, no i18n, bundle 200KB) and P1 (multi-tenancy, workflow engine)
- Resource planning: 15-person team, $1.57M budget, expected ROI
- Risk matrix with mitigation strategies

### Removed Obsolete Documents
Cleaned up historical planning documents that were consolidated:
- `IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md` (26KB)
- `OBJECTOS_INTEGRATION_ROADMAP.md` (14KB)
- `UPDATE_SUMMARY.md` (12KB)
- `ROADMAP_CONSOLIDATION_SUMMARY.md` (6.5KB audit trail)

### Preserved
Console-specific planning remains in `apps/console/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md` as it wasn't consolidated into the main roadmap.

## Structure

```markdown
ROADMAP.md
├── Executive Summary (strategic goals)
├── Current Status (achievements + gaps)
├── Q1-Q4 2026 Roadmap
├── Annual Targets (metrics table)
├── Resources ($1.57M budget, team structure)
├── Risk Management
└── References (links to source docs)
```

Single source of truth for project direction with clean repository structure.
